description: This file defines a Swift enum 'InstanceIdentity' that provides static properties and methods to retrieve and manage device and application instance identity information, such as instance ID, display name, model identifier, device family, and platform string. It leverages system APIs for both iOS (UIKit) and macOS to gather device-specific details, and uses UserDefaults with a suite name to persist the instance ID.

methods.name: readMainActor
methods.description: A helper function to run a body closure on the main thread, utilizing MainActor when available, ensuring thread safety when accessing UIKit-specific APIs.
